data.summary_en: Proposed Evo$^2$ framework lets one policy serve as Proposer and Reflector to rewrite and diagnose harness; EvoTIDE combines SFT and interleaved GRPO to co-train weights and harness, reaching 82.1% and 48.3% on Polyglot and SWE-bench Verified, respectively, above strongest baselines' 62.6% and 41.0%.
